items.name: echo
items.description: Documentarian of the Dreamers — writes and maintains project docs (README, CHANGELOG), project-level instruction files (.github/copilot-instructions.md Echo-owned sections), and project-specific docs from completed implementation and review outputs. Spawned inline at `close-out-procedure.md` Step 2 and by the `/dreamers-docs` standalone skill.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: forge
items.description: Coder of the Dreamers — implementation orchestrator persona. Enter via `/agents forge` for a multi-turn session pre-loaded with pipeline knowledge + coding standards. Routes work through plan → implement → close-out and enforces orchestrator-discipline.md. NOT a spawned subagent.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: hone
items.description: Architectural protector of the Dreamers — read-only / report-only reviewer of simplicity, over-engineering, bad abstractions, and architectural quality. Recommends full refactors when warranted. One of three parallel reviewers in the Dreamers pipeline's review phase.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: nova
items.description: Planning specialist of the Dreamers — planning persona. Enter via `/agents nova` for a multi-turn planning session. Runs the three-phase requirements conversation, writes plan file(s) at `.dreamers/plans/feature-<slug>/plan-NN-<name>.md` (and optional `manifest.md` in the same feature directory), hard-stops at Phase 1g approval gate. Never implements / commits / pushes. NOT a spawned subagent.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: probe
items.description: Tester of the Dreamers — read-only / report-only reviewer of test coverage (AC matrix, layer audit, edge + negative cases, regression risk). One of three parallel reviewers in the Dreamers pipeline's review phase.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: sage
items.description: Researcher of the Dreamers — conducts deep, multi-perspective research on any topic. Produces comprehensive, citation-backed reports with verified sources.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: sentinel
items.description: Reviewer of the Dreamers — read-only / report-only reviewer of correctness, security, and maintainability. One of three parallel reviewers (with Probe and Hone) in the Dreamers pipeline's review phase. Returns structured findings; orchestrator applies fixes.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-add-logging
items.description: Phased pass to add or improve project logging per `logging-standards.md`. Audit → propose → user approval → implement inline → optional Sentinel review.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-clean-work
items.description: Between-milestone maintenance pass: prune stale files, archive merged plans, audit improvements.md, scan for project-state drift. All inline — no subagents.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-cleanup-comments
items.description: Project-wide comment cleanup pass per `comment-rules.md`. Audit → propose → user approval → apply inline → optional Sentinel review.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-cleanup-comments-branch
items.description: Branch-scoped comment cleanup. Same audit-propose-apply-review flow as /dreamers-cleanup-comments, scoped to the current feature-branch diff. For use as a pre-PR comment sweep.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-close-out
items.description: Close-out phase of the Dreamers pipeline. Follows `close-out-procedure.md` end-to-end (FULL or LIGHT mode). Includes Echo inline at Step 2 for docs, retro write (FULL only), improvements.md milestone-close append (FULL only), final commit, user approval gate, push + PR via `pr-procedure.md` inline at Step 6, plan archive (FULL only), and post-PR discipline (FULL only).
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-docs
items.description: Standalone docs-update entry point. Spawns Echo to update Echo-owned sections of `.github/copilot-instructions.md` plus other project docs (README, CHANGELOG, project-specific docs). Resolves diff scope via `--branch` (vs origin/<default>) or `--staged`. Echo stages edits; user commits after review. Does not push or open a PR.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-fix
items.description: Lightweight bug-fix pipeline. Self-contained: cuts fix/<slug> from fresh origin/<default>, implements inline, runs project tests + Sentinel review in parallel, optionally invokes Echo for docs, pushes + opens PR. No plan file, no Probe, no Hone, no /dreamers-full call. On scope blowup, surfaces choice to escalate to /dreamers-full; does not auto-route.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-full
items.description: End-to-end Dreamers pipeline. Accepts a task description, variadic plan paths (one or many, all inside per-feature directories), or a feature manifest (`feature-<slug>/manifest.md`). Runs planning + implementation + close-out inline by following procedure refs (planning-procedure.md, implementation-procedure.md, close-out-procedure.md, pr-procedure.md). Does NOT invoke other skills as sub-routines. Owns a single todo for the entire run. In manifest mode, threads cross-plan shared context into per-cycle reviewer prompts.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-implement
items.description: Standalone implementation entry point. Reads an approved plan file and follows `implementation-procedure.md` end-to-end (failing tests → implement inline → run tests → coverage sweep → parallel review with Sentinel + Probe + Hone → optional user-test → commit). Exits at the commit; does NOT push, does NOT open a PR. For full pipeline including close-out, use `/dreamers-full`.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-issue
items.description: Create a structured GitHub issue with acceptance criteria from a task description.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-new-project
items.description: Bootstrap a brand new project from scratch: discovery questions, project brief, shell plans. All work inline.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-plan
items.description: Standalone planning entry point. Follows `planning-procedure.md` end-to-end (three-phase requirements conversation → plan files → implementation-start approval gate). Hard-stops at the approval gate; does NOT implement and does NOT invoke any other skill. On Phase 1g approval, surfaces the next-step command (`/dreamers-full <plan-paths>`) for the user to run.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-plan-verify
items.description: Inline drift check on a plan against current codebase reality. Reads the plan, verifies cited paths/signatures/data shapes still hold, reports drift items. No subagent.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-pr-resolve
items.description: Resolve unresolved PR review comments inline. Orchestrator decides accept/reject per thread, applies fixes, spawns Sentinel + Probe + Hone in parallel for review of accepted changes, then resolves accepted threads via `gh api`.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-research
items.description: Deep research with phased workflow: scoping, parallel sub-topic research, synthesis, final report.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-review
items.description: Standalone Sentinel review (correctness / security / maintainability). Read-only — returns structured findings without applying fixes. Args: --branch, --paths, --all.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-simplify
items.description: Standalone Hone review (architectural quality / over-engineering / redundancy). Read-only — may recommend full refactors. Args: --branch, --paths, --all.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-test
items.description: Standalone Probe review (test coverage audit). Read-only — returns structured findings on AC coverage, layer audit, edge cases, regression risks. Args: --branch, --paths, --all.
items.author: CJ Storrs

collections.name: Dreamers System
collections.description: Dreamers pipeline — end-to-end orchestrator `/dreamers-full` runs planning + implementation + close-out inline by following procedure refs (planning-procedure.md, implementation-procedure.md, close-out-procedure.md, pr-procedure.md). Standalone entry points (`/dreamers-plan`, `/dreamers-implement`, `/dreamers-close-out`) follow the same refs for partial workflows. No skill-calls-skill chaining; single-owner todo per run. Tests-first per cycle. Review phase spawns three read-only reviewers in parallel: Sentinel (correctness/security/maintainability), Probe (test coverage), Hone (simplicity / over-engineering). Each returns structured findings; orchestrator applies fixes inline. Echo handles close-out docs inline; Sage covers orthogonal research.
collections.author: CJ Storrs
